text: Bitcoin's modest 2% gain and Ethereum's stronger 5.3% rally suggest selective strength in established assets despite an Extreme Fear reading, indicating investors are cautiously accumulating rather than panicking. Bitcoin's dominance holding above 56% combined with $70B in daily volume shows the market retains structural stability, though the widening performance gap between BTC and ETH—with Ethereum outpacing Bitcoin—points to risk appetite slowly returning to larger altcoins. The 7-day decline in the Fear & Greed index despite price gains reflects underlying skepticism that any bounce may face overhead resistance.
